deviations: Feature-switch flake, root cause: the three collaboration switch tests and the pre-launch teaser test flipped a server-wide switch while other workers loaded pages that depend on it, so a parallel test occasionally saw the coming-soon page (200) or a 404 instead of its page (the 'stranger gets 200 instead of 404' failure in work-orders.spec.ts). Fix: those tests moved to tests/e2e/switches.spec.ts, run as the Playwright 'switches' project, a teardown of the mobile and desktop projects (runs after them whatever their result, alone, serial, one worker); the strict `expect(status).toBe(404)` assertion in work-orders.spec.ts is restored (the temporary expect.poll is gone). The retry policy (CI retries: 1) is unchanged; a test that passes on retry is reported by Playwright as flaky, never as a pass, and the counts below list flaky tests separately.
